explanations.checks: The rule rejects malformed command-line syntax before any domain work starts.

fixOptions.description: Fix the invocation per lekalo <command> --help; usage errors exit 2 and are owned by the CLI parser, not by DomainResult statuses.

explanations.rationale: It matters because usage refusals stay typed: scripts and agents get the stable cli.usage diagnostic instead of parser noise on stdout.
rootCauses: a required argument is missing or two flags conflict
an argument value is outside its bounded range or closed vocabulary

severityProfile.waiverPolicy: Not applicable: there is nothing to waive; correct the command line.

explanations.title: CLI usage error
